skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 35% ATK DMG to an entire column of targets with 4 combo strikes, with a 100% chance to inflict [Shatter] on the main target for 2 turns (reduces DMG RED. Rate by 30%). In addition, deals bonus damage equal to 50% ATK to enemies surrounding the main target.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 35% ATK DMG to an entire column of targets with 4 combo strikes, with a 100% chance to inflict [Shatter] on the main target for 2 turns (reduces DMG RED. Rate by 35%). In addition, deals bonus damage equal to 70% ATK to enemies surrounding the main target.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20% HP. After each action, if there is a Shattered enemy on the battlefield, gains [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 30% of its own HP).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20% HP. After each action, if there is a Shattered enemy on the battlefield, gains [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 35% of its own HP).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20% HP. After each action, if there is a Shattered enemy on the battlefield, gains [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 40% of its own HP).

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
